response.answer: Alan de Brauw is a leading researcher in nutrition and public health policy, known for his work on vouchers to increase fruit affordability in Nigeria and Vietnam, using randomized control trials to evaluate interventions. His studies focus on improving fruit consumption through economic incentives.

results.title: Vouchers to increase fruit affordability in Nigeria and Vietnam
results.content: We use a randomized control trial to study a voucher program designed to improve the affordability of fruits in peri-urban and urban settings in Vietnam and Nigeria, and analyze whether vouchers can increase fruit consumption.
